docs.sql: SELECT is_peak_hour, AVG(avg_temperature_c) AS avg_temp_c, COUNT(*) AS station_hours FROM marts.agg_station_hourly WHERE avg_temperature_c IS NOT NULL GROUP BY is_peak_hour ORDER BY is_peak_hour LIMIT 200

docs.question: Wie viele Minuten waren Stationen in der äußeren Zone insgesamt voll?
docs.answer: Stationen in der äußeren Zone waren insgesamt 165,26 Minuten voll.
docs.sql: SELECT SUM(full_minutes) AS total_full_minutes FROM marts.mart_station_kpis WHERE zone = 'outer' LIMIT 200

docs.question: Wie viel Prozent aller Stellplätze befinden sich in der inneren Zone?
docs.answer: 66,9 Prozent aller Stellplätze befinden sich in der inneren Zone.
docs.sql: SELECT zone, SUM(capacity) AS total_capacity, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(capacity) / SUM(SUM(capacity)) OVER (), 2) AS pct FROM marts.dim_station GROUP BY zone ORDER BY zone LIMIT 200
